name: Cave River
desc: A subterranean river running out of the dark — a passage recedes to a bright far reach where a skylight shaft rakes down through turning dust onto the water, stalactites hang receding along the roof, flowstone drapes the converging walls with gypsum sparkling on the rock, and the river widens toward the foreground carrying the shaft's reflection in a broken flow; warm limestone, glittering white gypsum, UV-fluorescent minerals on black, a cyan cave survey, or sumi ink.

energy.doc: how hard the light works — shaft brightness, water shimmer, mineral sparkle

scale.doc: how large the cavern is — passage width, stalactite and river size (rebuilds the cave)

density.doc: how many stalactites, flowstone drapes, sparkles, flow lines and drips

speed.doc: river flow, dust-mote and drip rate

shaft.doc: strength of the skylight beam and its pool of light on the water

damp.doc: how wet the cave is — drip amount and reflection strength

hue.doc: palette hue shift off the default warm limestone

x.doc: position of the far reach and the skylight shaft

y.doc: the near waterline — also sets how high the far reach sits

style.doc: aesthetic: limestone = warm cave, amber shaft, teal river, chiaroscuro; gypsum = cool white crystals glittering; blacklight = UV fluorescence, minerals glowing green-violet on near-black; blueprint = cyan cave-survey schematic, no photo shading; ink = sumi tonal wash

act.doc: multi-minute programme — a steady river, a flood rising with faster flow and more drips over sections, or a still calm pool with fewer drips and a fuller reflection

seed.doc: regenerates the cavern walls, stalactites, flowstone, sparkle and river

alpha.doc: how far the world sits back behind the performers
